digest_of delegates to Core intent::canonical then digest_bytes; digest_bytes delegates to Core hash_bytes and Digest32::from_hex. from_hex requires64 bytes and nibble accepts digits/lowercase a-f. No digest result for embedded members is asserted.

RelationIdentity fields include source_sha256; its digest constructs BoundIdentity without that field. Profile digest input names Core language/semantics/logical profile and relation format/version. This records serialized input selection, not binding adequacy.

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
pub struct RelationIdentity {
    pub relation_format: String,
    pub relation_version: u64,
    pub language: String,
    pub semantics: String,
    pub logical_cost_profile: String,
    pub profile_digest: Digest32,
    pub program_hash: Digest32,
    pub source_sha256: Option<Digest32>,
    pub action: String,
    pub action_index: u16,
    pub shape_digest: Digest32,
    pub compiler_build: CompilerBuild,
    pub compiler_build_digest: Digest32,
    pub adapter: StatementAdapter,
    pub logical_work: UInt,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct BoundIdentity<'a> {
    format: &'static str,
    relation_format: &'a str,
    relation_version: u64,
    profile_digest: Digest32,
    program_hash: Digest32,
    action: &'a str,
    action_index: u16,
    shape_digest: Digest32,
    compiler_build_digest: Digest32,
    adapter: StatementAdapter,
    logical_work: UInt,
}

impl RelationIdentity {
    /// Digest of the bound components only (never the raw source digest).
    pub fn digest(&self) -> Result<Digest32, CompileError> {
        digest_of(&BoundIdentity {
            format: "mori-r1cs-relation-identity/1",
            relation_format: &self.relation_format,
            relation_version: self.relation_version,
            profile_digest: self.profile_digest,
            program_hash: self.program_hash,
            action: &self.action,
            action_index: self.action_index,
            shape_digest: self.shape_digest,
            compiler_build_digest: self.compiler_build_digest,
            adapter: self.adapter,
            logical_work: self.logical_work,
        })
    }
}

claims.sourceObservation: SlotEncoding width is1 for Small/Bool,2 for Digest/UInt,3 for Wide; Type UInt/Bool maps to the corresponding encoding. Wide has lo:u128 and top:u16; plus uses overflowing_add and wrapping_add.

StatementLayout holds header,slots,field_count; slots carry kind,encoding,offset,label. TransitionValues contains inputs,pre,post,effects,cap. BodyValues stores states,cells,duties; DutyValue stores present/amount.

build appends header fields in order relation version,program hash,profile digest,action index,shape digest,compiler build,logical work,optional public cap; then inputs; then pre followed by post states,cells,duty present/amount; then effects; then optional gross/fees per debit cell.
Builder::push records current offset and increments by encoding.width. Layout build computes ShapeDescriptor digest, calls profile_digest and build.digest for header, and returns field_count=offset.

encode calls check_values then accounting_summary, walks slots, maps values through field helpers, checks each field-vector width and returns the vector. UInt fields are low64/high64; digest fields use halves; Wide uses low64,high64,top.

check_values checks input count/type,pre/post body counts/state types,absent duty with nonzero amount,effect count/variant types,then exact cap presence matching. This does not assert transition correctness.

StatementAdapter declares DirectFieldV0,ClaimantBoundAbiV1Pending,SettlementHashV2. admits returns Ok for DirectFieldV0,Unadopted for pending v1,or calls initial_ledger_target_admits for SettlementHashV2.

initial_ledger_target_admits scans every action and every statement; the first Emit returns TargetRefusal containing action/ordinal/name; if no such branch is taken the function returns Ok. No call was executed.

public_input_count returns layout.field_count for DirectFieldV0,Unadopted for pending v1,and2 for SettlementHashV2. Generic public_inputs routes Direct to layout.encode but returns an error requesting context for SettlementHashV2.

Generic bind contains DirectFieldV0 slot/claim length checks and input/enforce_eq calls; pending v1 and SettlementHashV2 return errors. In circuit synthesis the SettlementHashV2 branch explicitly calls abi2::bind_v2, while other variants call adapter.bind.
options_ok sequentially requires cap NotBound,accounting GrossDebitAndFees,frame TouchedOnly. The source error strings about target behavior are not independently verified here.
Constants declare STMT_TAG,FAMILY_V2,SHAPE_TAG and HEADER_LEN343. ContextV2 field lengths/types and bytes() append order are explicit, including consumed_ix and seq big-endian.

shape_bytes appends shape tag,sorted/deduplicated assets,states,inputs,cells,duties,effects,debit cells,statement count,liability-statement count,action name/index; lengths/indices use u16 try_from and big-endian. Type tags are UInt0/Bool1; effect tags are State0/Transfer1/Fee2/Liability3 with origin0/1; Emit returns an error.
constants calls shape_bytes,then blake2b256(shape_bytes),then body_len converted to u32. body_len skips headers and uses UInt16/Bool1/Wide18 bytes, rejecting other nonheader encodings.

body_bytes walks nonheader slots and appends input/pre/post/effect/accounting bytes; UInt uses16 big-endian bytes,Bool0/1,Wide top2 then lo16. statement_bytes checks exact body length then appends tag,family,predicate digest,shape digest,context,body length and body.

statement_v2 checks ABI2 presence→check_values→body_bytes→statement_bytes; public_inputs_v2 checks field then hashes statement. ABI2 public_inputs calls blake2b256 and converts first/last16 digest bytes as big-endian u128 values passed to fe.

bind_v2 checks wire count,honest statement length,and claimed length2; appends constant tag/family/digests,free context bytes112..339,constant body length,and nonheader wire-derived bits; checks total bit count; calls blake2b256_gadget; allocates2 inputs and enforce_eq with digest_half_lc.

free_bytes calls alloc_bit per context bit; limb_bytes either emits constants or allocates bits,adds weighted Lc terms,and calls enforce_eq. UInt serializes high limb then low; Wide top,mid,low. These are calls, not evidence that gadget/field constraints are adequate.

StagedAdmission stores StagedProgram and source digest. StagedLoweringPlan stores profile/format/hash fields,StoredCapParameter,actions and remaining strings. StoredCapParameter has only ExplicitPublicSlot; that enum label does not construct executable public slots.
